title: Hosts on the internet, 1981–2019 (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of the number of internet hosts. August 1981, 213; August 1983, 562; February 1986, 2,308; January 1989, 80,000; January 1992, 727,000; January 1995, 4.85 million; January 2000, 72.4 million; January 2005, 318 million; January 2010, 733 million; January 2019, 1.01 billion. Data: to 1992, Lottor, RFC 1296 (host tables to 1986, then the ZONE program); from 1995, the Internet Systems Consortium's Domain Survey, whose method changed in 1998 and which ended in 2019.
heading: INTERNET HOSTS · LOG SCALE
